Olivia (Acme Corp): Hey team — we removed the OKTA group 'prod-engineers' a few hours ago but 12 users still have the "engineer" role in Redwood and can access Dedicated resources. Not sure if SCIM deprovisioning failed or if role mapping didn't update. Happening since ~10:12 UTC. Can you check?

Maya (CSE): @Olivia sorry about that — can you paste the group push logs or the SCIM connector history from Okta? Did you do a full group delete or a membership change? :thinking:

Olivia (Acme Corp): I deleted the group entirely (Group > Actions > Delete). Okta shows a successful push at 10:12 with 200 -> shows payload had "members": [] in the group object. I attached the webhook payload snippet: ```json
{
  "id": "00g123-groupid",
  "displayName": "prod-engineers",
  "members": []
}
```

Maya (CSE): OK that helps. Two quick checks: 1) SCIM token used by Okta — does it have both read and write scopes? we need write to accept member removals. 2) Can you confirm your group-to-role mapping config (in Console > SCIM > mappers)? Any regex transforms on displayName/externalId?

Olivia (Acme Corp): Token has scopes `scim:read scim:write` per our admin. Mapper is a simple exact match on group.externalId -> role "engineer". No regex.

Rajat (Eng): Posting theory: Okta's group delete sends a group object with empty members array. Our SCIM handler treats a completely missing members key and an explicit empty members array differently: in one codepath we interpret missing as "no change" (because Okta sometimes omits members in incremental pushes) whereas explicit [] should be treated as full removal. Looks like the payload had members: [] but our service went through the incremental branch because the group delete event used PATCH-like semantics (we didn't detect delete). We'll need to check the delta detector around group.delete events.

Rajat (Eng): Repro steps I used locally: 1) create group in Okta 2) map to role via externalId 3) remove all members then delete group -> our webhook handler logged: \`Ignoring delta (no members key)\` even though payload had members: []

Rajat (Eng): Quick log excerpt from local run: ```
[2026-03-15T10:11:22Z] webhooks: received group.delete id=00g123
[2026-03-15T10:11:22Z] scim: delta-check -> members key present=true size=0 -> route=incremental
[2026-03-15T10:11:22Z] scim: incremental-branch -> skip-member-removal
```

Maya (CSE): So this is a bug in the detection logic. Can you confirm whether the user -> role link still exists in the identity store? Olivia, can you run this API call to list role members and paste results? ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDB_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/roles/engineer/members"
```

Olivia (Acme Corp): Ran it — shows 12 members with emails. Example: `alice@acme.com`.

Lexi (Support): @Rajat any mitigation steps we can apply from our side while eng fixes detection? Manual deprovision script maybe?

Rajat (Eng): Yes — we can force remove role assignments by calling the deprovision API for each user. Example (use admin token): ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/bulk-deprovision" \H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \H "Content-Type: application/json" \d '{"users":["alice@acme.com","bob@acme.com"],"reason":"okta-group-delete-sync"}'
```
This will unassign the role immediately. I'll prepare a small script and a safe checklist.

Maya (CSE): Also ask customer to revoke and re-create the SCIM token if it was created before recent write-scope tightening; ensures no scope edge cases.

Olivia (Acme Corp): We're OK with manual removals. Please proceed and confirm when done. Also please add me to the ticket.

Rajat (Eng): I've created internal ticket ENGR-4217: "SCIM: treat explicit empty members arrays as deletion/delta for group pushes". PR with fix + unit tests target is EOD tomorrow. For now, @Lexi please follow the manual deprovision plan: 1) run bulk-deprovision with the 12 emails 2) confirm role members list returns empty 3) run recon job (one-off) to validate no other stale role links.

Lexi (Support): On it. Running step 1 now. Will paste output when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

SCIM-Bot: bulk-deprovision job run initiated by Lexi. Job ID: scim-job-20260315-001. ETA ~2m.

Lexi (Support): Job finished. Output: `{"removed":12,"skipped":0,"errors":[]}` 

Maya (CSE): Olivia can you verify access for a sample user (alice@acme.com)?

Olivia (Acme Corp): Confirmed — alice lost the engineer role and can no longer access dedicated cluster. Thanks.

Maya (CSE): Closing loop: Eng will roll the fix to treat explicit empty member arrays as a removal in group-change detection and add additional logs to make future debugging easier. We'll also add a reconciliation sweep (daily job) that compares group membership vs role assignments and reports anomalies. I'll add you to ENGR-4217, @Olivia.

Olivia (Acme Corp): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
